create_judge_factory: create a JudgeFactory instance that maps judge config types to their corresponding judge classes
instantiate_judge_from_config: instantiate a BaseJudge by calling the JudgeFactory with a GraphPerEventJudgeConfig or InContextJudgeConfig
register_judge_mapping: register a mapping between ScriptedGraphPerEventJudgeConfig and GraphPerEventJudge in the factory
handle_unknown_config: handle unknown config types by raising a ValueError when no matching judge class is found
use_callable_factory: use the callable JudgeFactory to produce the correct judge instance for any registered config type
